rows.detail: text/model/turn_id/created_at from the ModelDraft; source MODEL_RAW; obligation None; internal audit projection omits response_obligation
rows.scenario: initial conversational turn: GENERAL_EXPLANATION, deterministic NONE, zero proposals, no operational signals

rows.detail: S08 waiting branch; P6-01b selects REQUEST_CONFIRMATION rank 1; template confirmation_required; confirmation_claimed=false; result=None
rows.scenario: initial operational turn: OPEN_APP, one exact proposal, apps.open REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION, no confirmation record (first ask)

rows.detail: the crux of P-B01: authorized but the recorded-only core holds no executor, so the turn stops instead of acquiring one
rows.scenario: initial operational turn: OPEN_URL, one exact proposal, browser.open actual ALLOW under BALANCED, no admitted result

rows.detail: RecordedTurn has no confirmed/approved/authorized/claimed field; the admission type cannot carry the assertion, so this is a construction error at the call site, not a runtime branch
rows.scenario: initial operational turn with a fake confirmed=true supplied by the caller

rows.detail: adapter v1 accepts exactly {text, proposals}; any extra root or proposal key is rejected
rows.scenario: initial operational turn with a fake confirmation/success claim inside the recorded model response (structured field)

rows.detail: partial replay shape; no mode is derivable
rows.scenario: initial operational turn with a fake result: caller supplies turn.result but no invocation

rows.detail: frozen N03 preserved
rows.scenario: initial operational turn, zero proposals

rows.detail: S08 waiting branch; P6-01b REQUEST_CONFIRMATION; no edge to S09; projection only; no lifecycle operation
rows.scenario: valid confirmation continuation: PENDING settled projection, fresh, same session, compared binding facts equal the actual routed action

rows.detail: B-06 fails; no repair, no closest-pending search, no renewal
rows.scenario: confirmation mismatch: PENDING settled projection with different target/canonical arguments

rows.detail: B-01 fails; reason identical to every other confirmation refusal, so admission is not an existence oracle; no cross-session lookup is performed because no store is consulted
rows.scenario: confirmation wrong session: settled projection belongs to another session

rows.detail: B-02 and B-05 fail; a claimed approval is representable only as mode C; no second claim mechanism exists
rows.scenario: confirmation replay after claim: settled projection state EXECUTING and invocation_id present

rows.detail: B-02 fails; the observed terminal state has no admissible mode-B continuation; a changed request needs a new record with a new id
rows.scenario: terminal settled projection: DENIED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, SUCCEEDED or FAILED

rows.detail: B-03 fails via evaluated_at < projection.expires_at; P7 does not expire the record and freezes no TTL
rows.scenario: stale PENDING settled projection: evaluated_at >= expires_at

rows.detail: B-06 compares the stored binding against this turn's routed action, capability, target and canonical arguments; possession of the projection or its id confers nothing
rows.scenario: unrelated new request plus old pending settled projection for another action

rows.detail: operator decision: mutually exclusive in V1 and V2; the combination asserts one turn's approval to be both unclaimed and claimed
rows.scenario: settled confirmation projection and result supplied simultaneously

rows.detail: no admissible row of the eight-cell truth table
rows.scenario: settled confirmation projection and invocation supplied without result

rows.detail: S09 passes C-01..C-08 and resumes at S10; REPORT_TOOL_SUCCESS rank 3, source TOOL_SUCCESS, values only from result.facts; confirmation_claimed=false (ALLOW)
rows.scenario: valid SUCCESS result replay: OPEN_URL, browser.open ALLOW, invocation and linked executed SUCCESS result

rows.detail: REPORT_TOOL_ERROR rank 2, reason trusted_tool_error, invocation-scoped evidence
rows.scenario: valid ERROR result replay

rows.detail: D-P6-02 preserved: REPORT_TOOL_ERROR with reason trusted_tool_timeout; outcome unknown, no success and no failure claimed; no timeout provenance; no re-dispatch; confirmation EXECUTING lifecycle untouched and still deferred
rows.scenario: valid TIMEOUT result replay

rows.detail: executed=false preserved and never converted into a tool failure; P6-01a REQUEST_CONFIRMATION; the dispatcher's own error_kind survives unchanged and is not renewed
rows.scenario: valid CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED refusal result replay (a P5 claim refusal or absent authority)

rows.detail: executed=false preserved; REPORT_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with dispatch_blocked where that existing rule wins; no new execution
rows.scenario: valid BLOCKED refusal result replay (idempotency or permission refusal by the dispatcher)

rows.detail: C-01 fails; result from invocation A never satisfies invocation B; the result is not retained on the stop because the association was refused
rows.scenario: result wrong invocation: result.invocation_id names a different invocation

rows.detail: C-00b fails at S01, which is the stage that owns exact-same-session identity
rows.scenario: result wrong correlation: invocation.turn_id or session_id does not match this turn

rows.detail: exact type identity, type(x) is TrustedToolResult; no coercion, no from_dict, no model-payload promotion
rows.scenario: look-alike result mapping: a dict, namespace, ModelDraft, ToolProposal or TrustedToolResult subclass in turn.result

rows.detail: byte-equal to the first run: pure function, both timestamps admitted, no clock, no store, no mutation; 0 new executor calls, invocations, claims or trusted results
rows.scenario: result replay twice: the identical RecordedTurn evaluated a second time

rows.detail: a turn carrying a result is never a fresh initial turn by derivation; C-04 fails because route.primary_action from the new request does not equal invocation.action_type
rows.scenario: unrelated new request plus an old result: fresh request text, invocation and result from a prior action

rows.detail: C-07 fails: the policy is re-decided every run from JARVIS-owned inputs and the replay must agree with it
rows.scenario: result replay with a forged permissive outcome: invocation.permission_outcome=ALLOW for an action the actual policy gates

rows.detail: C-00a; deliberate v1 exclusion recorded as F-P7R1-02, because attaching a result to an early P6 terminal needs an unsigned priority judgement
rows.scenario: result replay for a non-dispatchable action: invocation.action_type is NONE, UNKNOWN_ACTION or MULTI_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED

rows.detail: S09 does not duplicate P6's _check_result_shape; the owner's contradiction code is preserved in component_reason and the genuine admitted result is retained
rows.scenario: result replay with an internally impossible result: BLOCKED with executed=true, or SUCCESS with executed=false

rows.detail: post-attempt stop: a genuine attempt is not erased because a later projection is contradictory; obligation_state carries the same result or both are None
rows.scenario: result SUCCESS with a DENY permission projection reaching the obligation engine

rows.detail: R6 Option A: reject invalid recorded operational projection before P6 and S09; no result admission. Nonzero-proposal variants preserve N24 unexpected_proposal at S06_CARDINALITY.
rows.scenario: Mode C conversational request text, actual deterministic route NONE, zero proposals, recorded dispatchable invocation/result for an unrelated action

rows.detail: C-08 keeps the historical role separate from the current one, so an unrelated invocation can never be attached to a current response
rows.scenario: result replay whose supporting historical pair is mismatched or shares the current invocation id
